name: Chicken
notes__en: The Chicken is the first pet most players hatch: its egg sits in the Forest right next to your base and hatches faster than any other. It has the lowest base income in the game, so it is a starter pet you replace quickly. We used a Golden Chicken for our first in-game test of the income formula, and the result matched.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Dog
notes__en: The Dog earns twice what a Chicken does and is the second Common in the Forest. Its base weight is much higher than the Chicken's, so a Dog that looks heavy is often just an average Dog. Weight only boosts income compared with the pet's own base weight.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Bird
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Burrowing Owl
notes__en: The Burrowing Owl is the first Rare in the Forest and the lowest-earning Rare in the game. The wiki does not list a hatch time for its egg yet. It is a fine stepping stone, but the Raccoon from the same biome earns more.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Raccoon
notes__en: The Raccoon is the better of the two Forest Rares and out-earns the Burrowing Owl. Its egg takes under a minute to hatch, so it is easy to farm before you train enough Speed for the Lake.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Fox
notes__en: The Fox is usually the first Epic players get, from the Forest. It earns many times more than any Common or Rare in the same biome, which makes it the first big jump in income. Its egg takes longer to hatch than the Rares around it.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Bear
notes__en: The Bear is the strongest Epic in the Forest and earns more than the Fox. It is also heavy for an Epic, so compare its kg against its base weight, not against other pets. Only the Forest Legendary beats it in that biome.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Brr Brr Patapim
notes__en: Brr Brr Patapim is the Legendary of the Forest and the best pet in the starting biome. It is one of the meme-style brainrot pets. Its base weight is very high, so a Patapim's large kg number is expected rather than a sign of a rare roll.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Frog
notes__en: The Frog is the first Common you meet in the Lake. It is one of the lightest pets in the game, so even a small Frog can be above its base weight and earn a little extra. It out-earns both Forest Commons, which makes it a cheap early upgrade once you can reach the Lake.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Duckling
notes__en: The Duckling is the stronger of the two Lake Commons, a step above the Frog. Like the Frog it is very light, so check the kg on its card before you compare two Ducklings. Among Commons only the Desert's Jerboa earns more.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Catfish
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Turtle
notes__en: The Turtle is the Lake's only Rare. It has a heavy base weight for a Rare, so big numbers on a Turtle's card are normal and do not mean extra income by themselves. It earns more than both Forest Rares.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Trulimero Trulicina
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Swan
notes__en: The Swan is the Lake's top Epic and also the pet that guards the Lake on the wiki's zone table. It out-earns the Trulimero Trulicina from the same biome and both Forest Epics. It is light, so small weight gains still raise its income.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module

name: Axolotl
notes__en: The Axolotl is the Lake's Legendary and out-earns Brr Brr Patapim. Unlike Patapim it is light, so the weight bonus kicks in at a much smaller kg. It is a strong early-game target once you can reach the Lake.
source_note: Base income and weight from the wiki pet data module
